correctness.rationale: In AG(2,3), three distinct points form a line precisely when their sum vanishes. The five-arc contradiction counts ten lines containing pairs and all twenty incidences, leaving two lines in a four-point complement. Every weak colouring of nine points then uses all three colours with the stated three compositions. Counting equal-colour pairs shows exactly the (1,4,4) type is strict. With the singleton at the origin, strict colourings assign pairs of the four line directions to the other colours; each such four-point class is line-free since a triple contains an opposite pair and has nonzero sum. This gives 162 assignments, no strict-to-strict edge, and affine/palette transitivity (send independent representatives of the designated two directions to any target pair). The independent full replay found 3762 vertices, 16848 edges, degree counts 162 of 8 and 3600 of 9, with exact recorded hashes, all eccentricities, and the stated legal shortest ten-move witness. For the replacement, the dedicated rooted replay verifies strict partner counts 32,22,16,80,8,1,2 at distances 4 through 10 and checks both distance-ten partners are cyclic palette permutations. Transitivity transfers both assertions to every root. Counting each unordered pair twice yields 2592,1782,1296,6480,648,81,162. The graph used for distances includes every weak state without quotienting. The revised verification retains the frozen front matter verbatim.
residual_risks: A bounded finite result only; shortest paths are in the weak graph, not the induced strict subgraph, and intermediate strict states are not excluded.

value.rationale: Strict bicolorings are a distinguished established constraint class, not an arbitrary slice. They allow no moves within the strict rule, so weak relaxation raises a natural metric question: how many legal steps actually separate the strict assignments? The endpoint table gives the full cost spectrum for a uniform strict root and identifies exactly the two palette changes attaining the large cost. It is not a reprise of the known palette size, static split, or ambient diameter.
residual_risks: Fixed canonical affine plane; the finite tally is not a general reconfiguration theorem or a measure of the number of available paths.
